editorial:
Imagine being a chill surfer from California and suddenly getting dumped in the middle of Ohio. That is exactly what happens to Mitchell, a laid-back teen who just wants to ride waves but ends up dealing with strict relatives and mean high school bullies. He teams up with his cousin Wiley, and together they try to survive the social nightmare of a new school. The whole vibe feels like a classic 90s teen flick, filled with awkward crushes, funny mishaps, and that specific brand of early 90s energy that makes you feel nostalgic even if you weren't a teen back then.

What really makes this one pop is the wild energy of the second half. While the start is a slow burn about high school drama, the action kicks in hard when things move to a plane. The pacing stays quick, and the acting is exactly what you want from a goofy comedy. It is not a masterpiece, but it is a total blast if you want something light. It is the perfect movie to put on when you just want to turn your brain off and have a good time.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a wild sequence on a plane. Mitchell and his friends end up in a huge fight with the bullies and some bad guys. After a lot of chaos and some scary moments in the air, the heroes save the day. Mitchell finally wins the respect of his peers and gets the girl. Everything ends on a high note with the bad guys defeated and the boys proving they are a lot tougher than they look.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s teen comedies and light action movies.
